description.en:
Jupiter is Zeroth's humanoid platform for interaction, training, simulation and front-of-house service. The manufacturer describes a compact human-shaped robot intended to operate in environments used by people, with both teleoperation and autonomous modes available for different task requirements.

Its positioning emphasizes combining human guidance with independent robot operation. The published product page provides a high-level application description rather than a complete, independently validated specification set, so manipulation capacity, mobility and supported autonomous workflows should be confirmed for the offered configuration.

specs.label: Teleop independence
specs.conditions: Jupiter supports both modes according to the manufacturer; autonomy limits and task outcomes unspecified.

sources.title: Jupiter — official source
sources.quote: It supports both teleoperation and autonomous modes
